regions.text: parties, Americans of all religions and of all colors, from
regions.explanation: From 17.36s to 24.64s (“parties, Americans of all religions and of all colors, from”), 2 pause(s) at punctuation shrank from 1.75 s to 275 ms on average. Pauses at punctuation mark the end of an idea and give the audience time to absorb it; running through them merges separate thoughts into one stream. Fix: Hold a clear pause at each punctuation mark, about as long as the reference.
